## Description

Please include a summary of the change, which module or script is affected, and the motivation behind it.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature or module
- [ ] Documentation update or translation
- [ ] Refactor / Performance improvement
- [ ] Hardware profile adaptation

## Checklist

- [ ] My code adheres to the project's architecture guidelines (idempotent, declarative, copy-and-generation).
- [ ] I have tested changes locally using `./install.sh --dry-run` and verified normal execution.
- [ ] No hardcoded absolute personal paths (e.g., `/home/<username>`) have been introduced; `$HOME` or relative paths are used.
- [ ] No sensitive credentials, tokens, or private hardware dumps are included.
- [ ] All relevant documentation in `docs/` has been updated and cross-links verified.
- [ ] Comments and documentation are written in clean American English (`en_US`).
